swarm.name: The Impression
swarm.blurb: A swarm of presses, copies, and collectors follows the traces left by objects as they change hands.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Sketch Hand
creatures.blurb: A loose workshop hand punches in the direction of the nearest unfinished line.

creatures.name: Solvent Moth
creatures.blurb: It strips marks from tools before the crew can read them.

creatures.name: Bell Scrapper
creatures.blurb: It steals loose metal under cover of a cheerful ringing.

creatures.name: Frame Guard
creatures.blurb: It shelters the other machines behind a stiff portrait frame.

creatures.name: Line Weaver
creatures.blurb: It draws replacement hands faster than they can be swept away.

creatures.name: Overrestorer
creatures.blurb: It fills damaged swarm joints with hard setting paste.

creatures.name: Ledger Seeker
creatures.blurb: Paper seekers take metal that has passed between owners.

creatures.name: Ticket Warden
creatures.blurb: It shuts a gate on anyone who misses its imaginary appointment.

creatures.name: Panorama Roller
creatures.blurb: A rolled city scene winds up for a long corridor rush.

creatures.name: Transformation Engine
creatures.blurb: It studies a mark, copies it, and uses the copy against its owner.

creatures.name: Monument Press
creatures.blurb: It shields its unfinished bulk, then swings a stone arm across the crew.

creatures.name: Endless Curator
creatures.blurb: It protects its press and keeps making drafts of the same missing design.

creatures.name: Exception Box
creatures.blurb: Its raised shapes help the crew feel a route around false markings.

creatures.name: Conservator Bench
creatures.blurb: Wren borrows its tools to mend damaged joints.

events.title: Two Faces
events.text: Two frames have swapped their painted faces. The clamps are closing.

options.label: Pry the clamps; take the loose coins
options.result: Kestrel frees the frames and pockets coins from the clamp.

options.label: Leave the coins; use the padded frames
options.result: Wren uses the padding to dress the crew’s scrapes.

events.title: A Missing Line
events.text: A drawn bridge ends at a blank gap. The workshop offers ink or spare fittings.

options.label: Draw a steady crossing
options.result: Ox learns to set his feet before the bridge flexes.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: The crew takes the fittings and crosses the old narrow ledge.

events.title: Buried Bell
events.text: A bell is trapped in rubble beside a box of supplies. There is time to reach one.

options.label: Lift the bell
options.result: Its strap makes a clean sling for Wren’s supplies.

options.label: Open the box
options.result: The box contains coins for the road.

events.title: Winding Key
events.text: A miniature train blocks the way. Its key fits a locked coin box too.

options.label: Wind the train
options.result: Watching the train’s run gives the crew a better charge.

options.label: Open the box
options.result: The box opens. The crew steps over the stationary train.

events.title: Repair Material
events.text: A cracked cup holds a stash. A roll of clean dressing is wedged beneath it.

options.label: Break the cup
options.result: The coins inside are loose; the dressing is spoiled.

options.label: Lift it carefully
options.result: Wren saves the dressing. The cup stays closed.

events.title: Raised Route
events.text: A tactile model offers a safe route. A second route passes a loose pouch.

options.label: Follow the raised route
options.result: The quiet route gives Wren time to tend the crew.

options.label: Take the exposed route
options.result: Ox retrieves the pouch on the way through.

story.intro: The swarm is hauling metal toward a press. Kestrel finds identical marks on tools and empty frames. Ox takes the front; Wren keeps the joints moving.

chapters.title: First impressions
chapters.text: Every copy bears the same unfinished mark. The crew assumes the swarm wants a die for stamping more of itself.

chapters.title: The missing line
chapters.text: The machines borrow marks from portraits, tools, and records. Kestrel finds that none is quite the shape the press needs.

chapters.title: A press full of drafts
chapters.text: Discarded copies pile up around the machinery. Wren notices that each carries a scrap of a different object’s record.

story.bossIntro: The Endless Curator clamps another blank under its die. It makes defenders from failed drafts and shields the press.
story.outro: The die breaks. Inside is a record of an exchange, copied again and again. The swarm takes the remaining fragments toward the next collection.

creatures.name: Ink Crawler
creatures.blurb: Its false raised ridges make familiar equipment hard to handle.

creatures.name: Token Courier
creatures.blurb: It rolls its local token straight through anyone in the way.

creatures.name: Shearwing
creatures.blurb: It wraps a tool in a clear sheet and flies off with it.

creatures.name: Guilloche Weaver
creatures.blurb: It loops protective lines around damaged machines.

creatures.name: Almost Mint
creatures.blurb: It stamps unfinished designs into disposable soldiers.

creatures.name: Note Checker
creatures.blurb: It freezes travelers while its two halves fail to line up.

creatures.name: Interest Vine
creatures.blurb: Cut one tendril and the remainder divides into new growth.

creatures.name: Lockkeeper
creatures.blurb: Its gate shuts around a current of rolling tokens.

creatures.name: Opportunity Hound
creatures.blurb: It rushes the crew and closes on anyone already hurt.

creatures.name: Bowman Indexer
creatures.blurb: It restores damaged machines while filing away their stories.

creatures.name: Debit and Credit
creatures.blurb: One half takes immediately. The other sends collectors.

creatures.name: Curator of One Value
creatures.blurb: It protects its collectors and sweeps aside anyone carrying a story it cannot price.

creatures.name: Card Keeper
creatures.blurb: It records different answers and helps Wren keep the crew on its feet.

creatures.name: Artifact Guide
creatures.blurb: It offers raised replicas and shields anyone examining them.

events.title: Local Token
events.text: A vendor offers supplies for a local token. A collector offers cash for it.

options.label: Trade with the vendor
options.result: The supplies include clean bandages.

options.label: Sell to the collector
options.result: The collector pays and rolls away with the token.

events.title: Check the Note
events.text: A trap table holds a useful checking lens and a purse behind separate shutters.

options.label: Take the lens
options.result: The crew learns to spot and clear a false mark.

options.label: Take the purse
options.result: The purse comes free before the shutters close.

events.title: One Envelope
events.text: The planner has enough for either medical supplies or spare change.

options.label: Buy bandages
options.result: Wren uses the bandages at once.

options.label: Keep the change
options.result: The crew keeps the coins for a later stop.

events.title: Blocked Lock
events.text: Tokens jam the lock. The crew can recover them or use the lever to practice a heavy strike.

options.label: Pull tokens from the gears
options.result: The crew keeps the recovered tokens.

options.label: Force the lever
options.result: Kestrel learns a heavier strike from the stubborn lever. The tokens wash away.

events.title: Woven Door
events.text: Wire curves cover a door. One strand leads to a technique card; another holds a purse.

options.label: Trace the long curve
options.result: Ox learns a new way to shield a companion.

options.label: Cut out the pouch
options.result: The crew recovers the pouch before the wire tightens.

events.title: Quiet Table
events.text: A keeper offers a rest or a lesson in feeling raised marks. There is time for one.

options.label: Rest at the table
options.result: Wren tends the crew in the quiet.

options.label: Study the replicas
options.result: The crew learns where a precise touch can interrupt a mechanism.

story.intro: The crew follows the fragments into a world of notes, tokens, and bargains. Ox carries the broken die. It is heavier than it looks.

chapters.title: A price for everything
chapters.text: The swarm sorts tokens and supplies by a single measure. Kestrel thinks it has moved on from making copies to collecting money.

chapters.title: Different answers
chapters.text: The same token means different things to different people. Wren finds that the swarm keeps the accounts of those exchanges and leaves much of the metal behind.

chapters.title: One value
chapters.text: The collectors compress every account into the same answer. Ox holds open a cabinet while the crew reads what the machines have kept: names of places, changes of hands, and gaps.

story.bossIntro: The Curator of One Value guards its collectors and sweeps loose records back into its cabinet. Its single measure leaves no room for the gaps.
story.outro: Among the records is a route to an older collection. The swarm is not trying to get rich. It is trying to reconstruct a lost history, and flattening every other history to do it.

creatures.name: Seal Mites
creatures.blurb: They clamp false seals onto anything that moves.

creatures.name: Medal Racer
creatures.blurb: It charges the first thing to cross its imagined finish line.

creatures.name: Garden Sampler
creatures.blurb: It takes living sprigs for an overcrowded specimen cage.

creatures.name: Two-Sided Sentry
creatures.blurb: Its armored face covers the mechanism that changes its story.

creatures.name: Library Collator
creatures.blurb: It binds mismatched records together and catches hands in the bindings.

creatures.name: Replica Presser
creatures.blurb: It sends out copies to hide its own worn edges.

creatures.name: Conservation Automaton
creatures.blurb: It polishes and repairs nearby machines until their marks disappear.

creatures.name: Garden Grafter
creatures.blurb: Its metal roots split and tighten around loose objects.

creatures.name: Circulation Train
creatures.blurb: It sends rolling shields ahead and sweeps the crew away from its cargo.

creatures.name: Transition Mint
creatures.blurb: It restrikes damaged scouts into new patterns while its heavy die comes down.

creatures.name: Pattern Copier
creatures.blurb: It turns the crew’s own methods back on them with a hard metal imitation.

creatures.name: Many-Storied Mint
creatures.blurb: It keeps producing copies and repairing itself while its wide die sweeps the room. The mismatched impressions it cannot reconcile jam its mechanism.

creatures.name: Library Index
creatures.blurb: It compares records without forcing them to agree, and repairs torn pages.

creatures.name: Conservator Rig
creatures.blurb: It shelters damaged objects and helps Wren stabilize them.

events.title: Replica Spill
events.text: A tracker hides among replica coins. A scavenger offers a tool or a purse for the batch.

options.label: Exchange them for a tool
options.result: Kestrel takes a tool suited to breaking shields.

options.label: Sell the batch
options.result: The scavenger pays for the replicas and picks out the tracker.

events.title: Living Sprig
events.text: A sampler carries a sprig toward its cage. A seed keeper offers bandages or coins for help.

options.label: Ask for bandages
options.result: Wren takes the bandages after the sprig is freed.

options.label: Ask for coins
options.result: The keeper pays the crew after the sprig is freed.

events.title: Rival Marks
events.text: Two patrols argue over their marks. A loose emblem can divert either patrol.

options.label: Divert the nearer patrol
options.result: Watching its formation teaches the crew a sweeping attack.

options.label: Divert the farther patrol
options.result: The crew retrieves a purse from the far doorway.

events.title: Lost Record
events.text: A sealed case and its record have been separated. The keeper can spare a treatment kit or money.

options.label: Return them for the kit
options.result: Wren opens the kit after the case and record are reunited.

options.label: Return them for payment
options.result: The keeper pays the crew for reuniting the case and record.

events.title: Trapped Cart
events.text: A scaffold walker is closing around a supply cart. One crate is within reach before the next beam falls.

options.label: Grab the medical crate
options.result: Wren recovers clean dressings.

options.label: Grab the coin crate
options.result: Ox pulls the coin crate clear.

events.title: Balance Pouch
events.text: A pouch rests on a scale. Removing it drops a heavy pan; holding the scale steady reveals how to brace under weight.

options.label: Take the pouch
options.result: The crew catches the pouch as the pan drops harmlessly to the floor.

options.label: Hold the scale steady
options.result: Ox learns to brace under a failing weight.

story.intro: The trail ends among coins, seals, weights, and records. Wren brings the fragments. Kestrel looks for the seam in the machine collecting them.

chapters.title: Two faces
chapters.text: The swarm takes both faces of a coin but files them as one account. Its copies disagree with the records they came from.

chapters.title: The gaps
chapters.text: The crew compares impressions with catalogues and finds the missing piece: the swarm’s first record was damaged. It has been trying to fill that gap with a single perfect story.

chapters.title: Room for more
chapters.text: Different accounts fit the same object. Wren keeps them separate. Ox clears a path for Kestrel to carry the conflicting impressions to the mint.

story.bossIntro: The Many-Storied Mint repairs itself and stamps out defenders. Kestrel feeds its die the mismatched impressions while Ox holds the line and Wren protects the records.
story.outro: The jammed die stops. The missing record stays incomplete, alongside the accounts that survived. The swarm’s remaining machines stop collecting and sort the fragments without erasing their differences. Wren labels the gap; Kestrel leaves it open.
